ideas.pitch: An automated computer vision platform that analyzes multi-temporal satellite imagery to detect unauthorized industrial expansion, land-use violations, and environmental changes on leasehold plots.
ideas.title: VisionGuard Industrial Land Compliance Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeting the Computer Vision theme explicitly requested by Chandigarh University judges, combining hard engineering satellite processing with real-world regulatory utility.

ideas.pitch: A real-time computer vision and machine learning app designed for university students to scan campus mess or canteen food trays, instantly estimating macronutrients, allergens, and dietary alignment.
ideas.title: NutriLens AI Campus Canteen Assistant
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly hits the Machine Learning and Computer Vision core themes with an immediate, highly relatable use case for judges and students at Chandigarh University.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered transaction monitoring and anti-money laundering risk detection platform that builds dynamic transaction relationship graphs combined with LightGBM risk scoring.
ideas.title: FinSight AML Graph Investigator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates advanced machine learning engineering and graph intelligence similar to successful enterprise hackathon winners, appealing to judges looking for deep technical execution.

ideas.pitch: A computer vision and video understanding platform that converts unstructured campus lecture recordings and security feeds into searchable, indexed, and queryable knowledge bases.
ideas.title: CampusEye Video Intelligence Indexer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages video intelligence and multimodal AI to solve a practical university problem, checking both the Artificial Intelligence and Computer Vision competition themes.

ideas.pitch: A machine learning pipeline utilizing Poisson regression and statistical backtesting to forecast campus resource bottlenecks, maintenance failures, or safety incidents based on historical temporal data.
ideas.title: PredictAI Campus Incident Forecaster
ideas.why_it_could_win: Brings rigorous predictive modeling and calibrated confidence intervals into a hackathon context, satisfying judges looking for robust mathematical machine learning models.
